follow-up time: Until spontaneous regression of ROP or death
cohort: 53 preterm babies born before 32 completed weeks and weighing less than 1500 g
finding: The prevalence of ROP was 47.2%, with higher prevalence in babies weighing <1300 g and those delivered before 30-week gestation, and supplemental oxygen, sepsis, multiple blood transfusions, and cesarean delivery were significantly associated with ROP development.
mod_finding: Delivery by cesarean section was significantly associated with the development of retinopathy of prematurity.
